title: Fix PDF export to use built-in fonts, no external resources, and direct synchronous download

requirements.text: Rewrite the pioneers PDF export utility (frontend/src/utils/pioneersPdfExport.ts) to use jsPDF with only built-in fonts (e.g., 'helvetica'), no custom font loading, no external image or asset loading, and no window.open() calls. Generate the PDF entirely from in-memory data and trigger the download synchronously using jsPDF's built-in save() method. The output should be a clean, functional PDF with black text on a white background and a basic bordered table layout showing monthly hours, totals, averages, and status per pioneer.

quotes: Use jsPDF with only built-in fonts (no custom font loading)
Don't try to load any external images or assets
Generate the PDF entirely from data already in memory
Trigger the PDF download directly from the button click event (synchronously)
Don't use window.open() or create new windows
Use jsPDF's built-in save() method which downloads directly
Use only default fonts available in jsPDF
Black text on white background
Basic table layout with borders
No logos or images (or make them optional and handle errors gracefully)

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the PDF export button on the Pioneers page triggers an immediate file download without opening a new window or tab
No 'bad URL' errors appear in the browser console during export
No popup blocker warnings are triggered
The generated PDF uses only jsPDF built-in fonts (helvetica or equivalent)
No external HTTP requests are made during PDF generation
The PDF contains a bordered table with pioneer data (monthly hours, totals, averages, status)
PDF has black text on a white background
